input: Research tuition costs for private music conservatories

gold.taskTitle: Research Tuition Costs for Private Music Conservatories
gold.taskDescription: Research and compile tuition cost information for private music conservatories.

questions.title: Which instrument or music discipline are you focusing on?
questions.description: Identify the specific instrument or music discipline (e.g., piano, violin, voice, composition) to narrow down relevant conservatories.

questions.title: What degree level are you researching tuition for?
questions.description: Determine whether the research is for undergraduate, graduate, diploma, or certificate programs.

questions.title: Which country or region should the conservatories be in?
questions.description: Establish the geographic scope of the research, such as the US, Europe, or a specific country.

questions.title: Are there specific conservatories you already have in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a target list of schools or wants a broad survey of options.

questions.title: Should the research include financial aid and scholarship availability?
questions.description: Determine if net cost after aid is relevant, or if the focus is strictly on sticker-price tuition figures.

questions.title: Is this research for yourself or someone else?
questions.description: Clarify who the prospective student is, as this affects factors like residency status, age, and eligibility.

questions.title: What will you do with this research once gathered?
questions.description: Understand the end goal, such as comparing schools, budgeting, applying, or advising someone, to shape how the information is organized.
